title: Show agent conversation summary and run metadata in the issue event history
description: Follow-up to kbs-3310c1. The issue detail Event History renders router.conversation events as provider, lifecycle, session, branch and an expandable redacted output. The event's own message (the agent's summary or the awaiting-reply text) and the run metadata (claim id, revision, worktree) are stored on the event but not displayed. Render them in packages/ui/src/kanban/TaskDetailPanel.tsx (case router.conversation) and confirm visually against the preserved run kbs-4c7198, whose console API already returns started, agent_turn and four recovered events.
